scope: Matched training-only same-voice comparison; reused development validation, no new holdout or board.
hypothesis: Training the score gap within a same-voice pair may help distinguish the acoustic contrast while retaining ordinary wake sensitivity.
pair_sampling: Eight pairs replace eight positive and eight TTS negative slots in each 128-row training batch in both arms. Same engine, corpus, fixed voice/preset, delivery metadata and rendering variant; exclude voice-description-only Qwen and multi-voice Piper. Independent seed 381 and same within-band phase draw; original representative inputs remain unchanged.
pair_objective: Both arms keep per-example weighted BCE. Treatment adds 0.5 * softplus(4 + negative log odds - positive log odds) per paired positive slot. This branch is removed before INT8 export.
advance: Require identical pair schedules and representative input bytes. The candidate needs zero continuous development events and <=1% worst engine/corpus and engine false fraction. To attribute improvement to ranking require at least 3 recall points over paired control at the same gate, or over the paired control at the 2% limit if it has no strict point. Report the whole grid and .97 fixed reference regardless. No promotion based only on reduced scores or low recall.
limits: These are synthetic voice presets; identity matching does not substitute for new speakers. A paired objective with a limited corpus is an exploratory screen, not acoustic acceptance.
